The paper does not directly measure the top quark mass in the lepton+jets channel. However, it does measure the top quark mass using a combination of eight lepton and dilepton distributions, including the lepton+jets channel, and obtains a value of m pole
t = 173.2 ± 0.9 ± 0.8 ± 1.2 GeV.
